items.quote:
the prophet who had brought him back saddled his donkey for him.
24  As he went on his way, a lion met him on the road and killed him
items.contrast: The man of God, who receives the saddled donkey and resumes his journey, versus the prophet who brought him back.
items.reason: The repeated pronouns could briefly suggest the nearer noun, “the prophet,” but “saddled his donkey for him” distinguishes the prophet from the traveler. The traveler is the man of God, so he is the one the lion kills.
